asset_publication.verification: S3 object-count/byte summary plus CloudFront HTTP 200, content-type and content-length checks for every COG and representative legends/target tiles.

methodology.target_selection: Top 15 eligible grade rows using the app's exact stakeAnswer formula, plus four mandatory seed districts. Eligibility is cited Au >= 0.3 oz/ton and nearest active-claim centroid >= 400 m. score = min(Au,5) * (1.35 when basis contains production or shipped, otherwise 1) + min(open_m,5000)/12500.
methodology.target_identity: MRDS dep_id when present; otherwise a deterministic state + county + canonical name + rounded-coordinate hash. Array indexes are retained only as transient conveniences.
methodology.quad_selection: Official USGS 7.5-minute map-index polygon containing each target plus the eight touching cells.
methodology.catalog_search: NGMDB geologic bedrock, surficial, and structural records intersecting the 3x3 quad neighborhood, representative fraction 1:1 through 1:62,500. Candidates sort newest first, then largest scale.
methodology.acquisition: Prefer GIS/GeoTIFF, then GeoPDF or the highest-resolution scan. Extract pocket plates at >=600 output dpi but record native source ppi so upsampling is never described as added detail.
methodology.georeferencing: Standard 7.5-minute neatlines snap to official quad corners. Irregular plates require reviewable GCPs; low-confidence fits remain disabled.
methodology.scoring_boundary: Raster visibility never changes WS6 scores. Only normalized native GIS unit polygons may feed a lexicon rescan.
methodology.gap_semantics: A gap is shown explicitly when no <=1:62,500 catalog record exists, no modern state-survey quad exists, acquisition is gated, reuse permission is unresolved, or georeferencing awaits review.

targets.gap: Modern-map gap: CGS has no modern Grass Valley quadrangle; North Bloomfield (2024) is adjacent. Johnston PP194 Plate 1 is the public-domain historical substitute.
targets.notes: Mandatory seed. Only PP194 Plate 1 is a planar overlay; Plate 2 is a section and Plates 27/32/35 are isometric mine diagrams.
